notes: Account background: product analytics platform for B2B SaaS (usage tracking + contextual help). Previously using OtherAPIInc for chat + embeddings.
Primary contact: VP Product - Aisha Noor. Heavy emphasis on parity with existing prompts and deterministic output for inline help flows.
Buying committee: VP Product (Aisha), Head of Engineering (Marco Li), Security (Tess Alvarez), Platform Eng lead (Ravi Menon).
Initial ask: proof that Redwood hosted API can replicate their 'help-compose' microflow and embeddings recall at same latency and <10% cost delta.
They prefer starting on Hosted to validate behavior then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation.

Migration story: migrating from OtherAPIInc. Want a compatibility shim in POC to minimize app changes (authorization header mapping and small client shim). Concerned about prompt regressions and tokenization differences.
Quote from demo: 'We cannot accept content regressions that change UX—must match edge cases in help content generation.' — Aisha Noor
Pricing sensitivity: mid range. Looking for hosted credits for POC and a committed Dedicated pricing band if POC passes (expecting 200-400k ARR).
Security: SOC2 required, SSO + SCIM earlier in procurement. Data residency for EU customers may be required later (they host EU customers).
Integration notes: embed ranker uses 512-d float embeddings now; ask: quantify embedding cosine parity and recall@10 delta when switching quantized models.
SE notes: run parity tests with identical prompt templates, seed system message, and comparator harness; capture top-k token diffs and BLEU-like metric for generation stability.
Pricing discussion so far: AE proposed hosted trial with tiered Dedicated estimate (baseline + burst). CFO wants clear cost per 1M tokens and per-embedding unit before buy-in.
Operational ask: rollout plan must include A/B canary (10% traffic) and automatic fallback to current provider on regression alerts.
Timeline: decision targeted Q2 2026 pending POC and legal sign-off.

requirements_summary: Two-phase migration: 1) Hosted API POC with compatibility shim to minimize application changes, measure prompt parity (generation diffs, recall metrics) and embedding recall/latency; 2) If parity within thresholds and SLOs met, onboard to Dedicated with VPC and committed capacity. Must support SSO/SCIM, audit logs, KMS integration, and EU data residency for subset of traffic.
migration_plan: Phase A (Hosted POC): provide SDK shim mapping OtherAPIInc calls to Redwood endpoints; run parallel testing harness for 2 weeks; telemetry: per-prompt diffs, latency p50/p95, cost per 10k tokens, embedding recall@10
Phase B (Canary): 10% traffic to Redwood Hosted + automated rollback if regression triggered
Phase C (Dedicated onboarding): set up VPC peering, KMS keywrap, migrate model pinning and rollouts, establish SLAs and run full load tests
migration_risks: Tokenization differences leading to subtle prompt output changes
Embedding dimensional or normalization mismatch affecting vector store recall
Latency spikes during peak due to batching mismatch
Legal delay on DPA and EU residency clause
poc_success_criteria: Generation parity: <5% functional difference on key prompt set per evaluation harness
Latency: p95 at or below 1.8x current baseline (target p95 <= 800ms for chat flows)
Embedding recall@10 within 2 percentage points of current vendor
Cost: projected Dedicated unit costs within 15% of current spend at expected throughput
